segments.motivation: To efficiently deliver projects, coordinate team tasks, and maintain clear overviews of progress.
To organize work, track tasks, customize workflows, and improve overall team productivity.
To manage all aspects of their business, from project completion to daily tasks, with versatility and ease.

tasks.context: with actionable items, assignees, and due dates

tasks.purpose: to suit different preferences (e.g., lists, Kanban, calendar, Gantt)

tasks.context: by assigning multiple people or sharing projects
tasks.purpose: to ensure team alignment and smooth workflow

benefits.claim: The platform offers extensive customizability and versatility, adapting to various organizational needs and workflows.
It provides a comprehensive set of features for task and project management, aiming to replace fragmented software solutions.
It improves team workflow and collaboration through clear task assignment, shared project views, and easy onboarding.

frictions.claim: The abundance of features can be overwhelming for new users, leading to a steeper learning curve.
Users may encounter UI/UX issues such as subtasks becoming hard to find, lack of undo functionality, or occasional glitches when setting up boards.
Specific AI features, like the chat interface, may have usability quirks requiring manual adjustments, such as resizing.

unknowns: Specific functionality and impact of 'AI Agents & Workflows' on daily tasks beyond basic AI summaries/chats.
User perception and practical application of 'Brain²' for context, personality learning, and model selection.
Reviewer experience with 'MCP Online Ambient Intelligence' for surfacing context and suggestions.
